title: Yoisaki Kanade — Memory Of A Warm Melody〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, I didn't have any technical skills or knowledge when it came to music. I really just composed as I went along...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was driven by the excitement I felt while playing the keyboard, and I was overcome with joy when I got the sound I wanted.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I remember staring at Dad's back while he composed. I kept wondering what was going through his mind...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And every time he produced a sound that I hadn't heard before, I always wanted to learn to do what he just did.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So many things went through my mind while I was composing my very first song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I have a pretty good idea of what I want to do now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't help but feel all this nostalgia.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mafuyu said this song is similar to that other song I composed a while back.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I also thought a lot about Mom and Dad while composing that song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The carnations should be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
None of them seem to be in bloom.
I guess it's the wrong time of year.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When Mizuki and I came here that other time, these flower beds all had white carnations in full bloom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I wish I could see them again...
But I guess there's nothing I can do right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I thought it was you!
I couldn't help but run over to make sure it was really you since it's super duper rare to see you in a place like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should start taking the early shift at work more often from now on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, are you just coming off a shift?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I was just wandering around thinking about what to get for lunch, and that's when I spotted you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
This is where we saw all those carnations, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I was hoping to see them again...
But now's probably not the right time of the year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, it's a good thing I decided to chase you down because I know a way to make all the flowers here bloom♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just play along for a bit.
Turn towards the flower beds and close your eyes for me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Mira-Mira-Miracle!
Make the flowers from Kanade's memories... Return!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, since this is one of my favorite spots.
I decided to take a video so that I can look at the flowers after they're all gone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The petals from the other flowers wafting in the breeze were so pretty that I wanted you to see them, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki...
I didn't think I'd get to see these flowers again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
I'm really happy that I finally got to show you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll send it over on Nightcord so you can watch it whenever.
